contentRating.instruction: Answer the actual IARC questions; do not guess or promise the final rating.
facts: Contains stylized fantasy combat and weapons; do not declare no violence just because the app is Productivity.
Family-connected interaction and user-written task/reward names must be considered in user-interaction questions.
No real-money wagering or purchased random prizes identified.
contentRating.wheelReview: The current roulette/casino-like art and chance-based wheel need review against the Families prohibition on real or simulated gambling. An earned family reward picker is not automatically gambling, but casino imitation creates avoidable risk. Recommend a clearly non-casino reward wheel with family prize icons, no betting, cash-out, paid spins or wagers; a category/wording change alone does not resolve actual mechanics.

dataSafety.status: Proposed inventory; do not submit until SDK/service details and sharing exceptions are checked.
dataSafety.encryptionInTransit: HTTPS/TLS is used; verify all shipped network paths. Do not describe this as end-to-end encryption.

Auth UID and parent/child link identifiers

dataSafety.optionalVsRequired: Classify per field and feature: notifications are opt-in, voice/camera are optional; account data is needed for cloud accounts. Guest mode alone does not make every collected account field optional.
dataSafety.sharing: Assess Firebase/Google/Expo processing under service-provider exceptions and explicit user-initiated family sharing. Do not mark “no sharing” simply because data is not sold.
additionalChecks: Speech audio handled by external device speech service: assess actual provider/network flow before answering Audio files.
QR camera scans appear locally processed; verify no image/frame upload before answering Photos/videos.
Review SDK diagnostic/network logs, retention and server logging before answering Diagnostics.
No evidence found for precise location, contacts, payment card details, health data or advertising identifiers; verify shipped manifest/SDK behavior.

permissions.camera: Optional parent QR scan; explain at use and retain code-entry alternative.
permissions.microphone: Android launches RecognizerIntent; app audio recording is disabled in Expo config. External speech processing still needs accurate disclosure.
permissions.notifications: Task reminders and family events, opt-in and controllable.
permissions.exactAlarms: Native module requests SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM for user-chosen task alarms. Do not substitute restricted USE_EXACT_ALARM or claim alarm-clock core eligibility without review.
permissions.foregroundService: Check merged manifest and any Console foreground-service declaration against alarm audio behavior.
permissions.otherDeclarations: Inspect the active Console dashboard for health, financial, government, news and other declarations. Ordinary virtual quest coins do not make this a financial-services app; do not invent business facts.
